In this case, we have to use the identity

$$
1+{cot}^{2}⁡x={csc}^{2}⁡x.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+3{csc}^{2}⁡x-3{cot}^{2}⁡x+4}}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+3({csc}^{2}⁡x-{cot}^{2}⁡x)+4}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+3(1)+4}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x+7}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\sqrt{x+7}\,{|}_{1}^{2} \\  & =\sqrt{2+7}-\sqrt{1+7} \\  & =\sqrt{9}-\sqrt{8} \\  & =3-2\sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
